caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a blonde woman in a black sports bra and high-waisted shorts. She stands in a hazy room framed by large multi-pane windows and a concrete pillar. A red resistance band is stretched taut around her upper thighs, and her fists are raised near her chest in a guarding stance. She holds this wide-legged position with the band continuously under tension, showing only subtle oscillations of her torso and knees. The camera drifts slowly around her, sliding the window grid and ceiling vent across the background so that she shifts from center-left toward center-right in the frame. Her feet stay planted apart, and the band remains in firm contact with both thighs throughout.
relations: Camera drift slides the window grid and ceiling vent across the background, shifting the woman from center-left to center-right.
